name: Seraph of the End
description: After a mysterious virus wipes out ninety percent of humanity, vampires emerge from the recesses of the earth to enslave mankind, treating them like livestock. After growing tired of donating blood in exchange for protection, 12-year-old Yuichiro Hyakuya and his best friend Mikaela Hyakuya plot an escape along with the other orphans. After being the only successful runaway, Yuichiro joins the Moon Demon Company, an extermination unit of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army dedicated to killing off vampires.

videos.title: Seraph of the Endless 1
videos.overview: The setup is simple: Shinoa, Yoichi, and Yuichirō are in a classroom or school environment. Shinoa plays a bit of mischief by giving Yuichirō a list of commands (e.g. "look at this", "turn there", etc.), via notes.

videos.title: Seraph of the Endless 2
videos.overview: Shinoa gives Yuichirō his “heart’s desire” (or makes him pick a desired reward) — comically over the top choices. Among the items are things like silver and golden axes, and also Shinoa merchandise. Yuichirō is shown reacting/choosing one, in a humorous way.

videos.title: Seraph of the Endless 3
videos.overview: In this episode, young Yūichirō and young Mika are having a moment in Sanguinem. Yūichirō asks Mika what’s on his mind. After some hesitation, Mika admits that he thinks he has more charm as a main character.

videos.title: Seraph of the Endless 4
videos.overview: Shinoa and Yoichi initiate a “hand‑slap game” with Yu. A hand‑slap or slap‑tag‑type game, where Yu keeps losing each round.

videos.title: Seraph of the Endless 5
videos.overview: They go to a library, where they find a book of secrets. They use a bitter‑tasting truth serum. As a side effect, Kimizuki and Yūichirō start behaving like dogs. They chase Yoichi around, and then fight each other.

videos.title: Seraph of the Endless 6
videos.overview: Kimizuki is tasked with driving the squad, but he takes a wrong turn. They end up at the Saigo Takamori Statue in Ueno.

videos.title: Seraph of the Endless 7
videos.overview: Mitsuba tries attacking Yu with several surprise moves — kicks, tickles, and other unexpected attacks. Yu tries to parry them. He struggles to keep up.

videos.title: Seraph of the Endless 8
videos.overview: Every time Guren tries to exit or leave, somehow he ends up back in the same room. This repeats multiple times.

videos.title: Seraph of the Endless 9
videos.overview: The Shinoa Squad is at school, and Guren is teaching them a lesson.

videos.title: The Beginning of the End
videos.overview:
A lifetime of tragedy - virus attack, captivation by vampires, failed escape plan, and deaths of his family - pushes Yu to live for revenge. However, the tragedy continues as he finds out that the vampires have turned Mikaela into one of them.

Recap of the first cour of "Owari no Seraph".

videos.title: Seraph of the End: Vampire Shahal
videos.overview:
A mysterious vampire named Shahal kidnaps a human girl named Riko. Shahal's true goal is unknown, and while he has kidnapped Riko, he refuses to drink her blood. Suddenly, he receives a visit from the vampire nobles Ferid and Crowley. Meanwhile, Guren tasks Shinoa Squad with rescuing Riko and returning her to her family.

Originally screened at Jump Festa 2015 events.

videos.title: Seraph of the Endless Nagoya Arc 1
videos.overview: This episode typically shows the characters preparing or discussing strategy with humorous twists, focusing on character interactions rather than serious combat.

videos.title: Seraph of the Endless Nagoya Arc 2
videos.overview: The characters face mishaps and misunderstandings during the battle preparations. There is plenty of humorous banter, with characters poking fun at each other’s quirks or abilities.Some gags revolve around the challenges of coordinating the squad or unexpected behavior from members.

videos.title: Seraph of the Endless Nagoya Arc 3
videos.overview: The episode showcases funny and exaggerated character interactions, often involving playful teasing or misunderstandings. Some scenes highlight the squad’s attempts to coordinate their strategy, but things comically go off-track. There are also moments poking fun at each character’s personality quirks or habits, adding charm and levity to the storyline.

videos.title: Seraph of the Endless Nagoya Arc 4
videos.overview:
The squad tries to tackle various problems during the arc, but their efforts often lead to humorous misunderstandings or blunders. There’s playful teasing, especially between Yuichirō and other squad members like Shinoa and Kimizuki. Some moments show the squad members struggling with teamwork or getting distracted by silly things, adding to the humor.

The episode may include parodies of serious scenes from the main Nagoya Arc but with exaggerated or goofy twists.

videos.title: The World of Blood Legacy
videos.overview: An epidemic of unknown origin strikes mankind, killing all adults and rendering the youngsters at the mercy of the vampire kind. Four years later, Yūichirō Hyakuya and his friends make a daring attempt to escape from the vampires, unaware that a mortal trap awaits them.

videos.title: Humanity After the Fall
videos.overview: Four years after escaping, Yūichirō is part of the Japanese Army and is eager to become a member of their special vampire hunting force, the Moon Demon Company, but his reckless behavior leads him to be suspended, until a vampire attacks the local school prompting him to face the enemy against orders.

videos.title: The Demon in Your Heart
videos.overview: Yūichirō learns that one of his schoolmates was possessed by a demon and decides to confront him not only in order to save him but to make a contract with the demon and obtain his power. However, he soon learns that subduing the demon will not be such an easy feat.

videos.title: Vampire Mikaela
videos.overview: Instead of dying with the rest of his friends, Yūichirō's best friend Mikaela was transformed into a vampire by Krul Tepes, the queen of the vampires and now works as her aide. Meanwhile, Yūichirō finally begins his training to become a member of the Moon Demon Company.

videos.title: Black Demon's Contract
videos.overview: Wary of the Human Army's rise to power, Krul calls the vampires to war against them, while Yūichirō and his friends are finally selected to attempt to claim a demon weapon for themselves, despite knowing the risks.

videos.title: New Family
videos.overview: After passing the final test, Yūichirō and his classmate Shihō Kimizuki obtain their own Demon Weapons, but when Yūichirō's friend Yoichi Saotome ends up possessed by his weapon, the duo must find a way to bring him back to his senses without killing him.

videos.title: Mitsuba's Squad
videos.overview: Yūichirō and his friends introduced to a new member, Mitsuba Sangū, and are then dispatched for his first mission as part of the Moon Demon Company, but when they spot a little girl in distress, Yūichirō ignores orders and rushes to rescue her, despite being warned that he is just being lured into a trap.

videos.title: First Extermination
videos.overview: After successfully clearing a vampire nest and rescuing the humans held captive, Yūichirō's party sets for the human base in Shinjuku, unaware that the vampires are attacking there. Upon arriving, they come across one of the vampire nobles, and find themselves at mercy of his overwhelming power.

videos.title: Vampire Attack
videos.overview: Yūichirō and his companions arrive at Shinjuku to help repel the vampire offensive, while Guren's party spots Mikaela and Ferid, and decides to face them.

videos.title: Results of the Choice
videos.overview: Yūichirō and Shinoa get separated from the others and after taking a wounded soldier to be treated, they regroup to assist Guren's party. In the occasion, Yūichirō and Mikaela finally meet again.

videos.title: Reunion of Childhood Friends
videos.overview: Mikaela attempts to escape, taking Yūichirō with him. However, seeing his friends at the mercy of the vampires, Yūichirō goes out of control when a dreadful power emerges from him, threatening allies and foes alike. Shinoa manages to stop him but he falls unconscious.

videos.title: Everyone's a Sinner
videos.overview: Yu has been in a coma for five days when Shinoa confronts Guren about special drugs in Yu's pill. He tells her to go and wait for Yu to wake up if she really cares for him. During the seventh day of his coma, Yu wakes up. He finds out that Mika retreated with the other vampires. Once all his friends have gathered he thanks them and apologizes to them. At the end of the episode both Yu and Mika promise themselves they will save the other.

videos.title: Human World
videos.overview: Shinoa spars against Guren before visiting Yu in the library. She tells him about turning humans into vampires. Then, Kureto Hiragi summons Yu to ask him about a vampire spy while torturing Kimizuki and Yoichi to make him tell the truth. Afterward, Yu asks Guren about it and asks if Mika would also be useful to him. In Sanguinem, Mika starves for blood and Ferid recommends halting his growth there. A child offers his blood to Ferid, and Ferid tempts Mika to drink the boy's blood but Mika refuses. Ferid then invites Mika to the Progenitor Council meeting.

videos.title: Complicated Connections
videos.overview: Yoichi eliminates five horsemen with one attack, and Yu begins the next step of his training. Yu battles against Asuramaru in his mind and defeats Asuramaru by asking to become friends. At the Progenitor Council meeting, Ferid discusses the battle at Shinjuku and has Mika present a video showing Yu's transformation. Krul strikes at Ferid and intentionally misses. Ferid explains that she cannot kill him. Kimizuki struggles in battle against Kiseki-o and faces memories where he was told to kill his sister. He breaks free and is victorious by remembering Yu's feelings for Mika, who are family even though they are not related by blood. Kimizuki and Yu show off their new techniques, and Shinoa and Mitsuba learn the files on the three boys have been erased.

videos.title: The Demon Army's Ambition
videos.overview: The child who contacted Ferid Bathory in the previous episode sends a letter via messenger pigeon to Aoi Sangu, who passes it on to Kureto. Shinoa Squad meets, and Kureto Hiragi and Guren Ichinose do the same. Kureto announces his plan to attack and wipe out ten noble vampires in Nagoya before the vampires bring their main army down on Japan in one month. Shinoa reveals that Yu tried to kill her during the battle in Shinjuku, and the squad considers whether to keep following Guren or not. Eventually, they decide to follow him and make their policy to protect their family. Meanwhile, Mika attacks Krul for her blood. Once he calms down, she reveals her plans to him and gives him a secret mission. Shinoa briefs Guren on her squad's success in training, and he gives her new orders. Mika meets with other vampires to head to Nagoya, and Kureto orders potentially lethal experimentation on Mirai Kimizuki.

videos.title: The Moon Demon's Orders
videos.overview: When the Shinoa squad arrives late, they realize just how serious this mission is for Guren. Knowing this is an impossible mission where many will die, Guren puts his emotions aside and orders his men to not necessarily survive, but to win.

videos.title: Livestock Revolt
videos.overview: The Shinoa squad and Narumi squad join forces to carry out their mission - to kill the Fifteenth Progenitor, Lucal Wesker. While they succeed in their mission without losing anybody, others were not so lucky. Nine teams fail and were taken as hostages...

videos.title: Sword of Justice
videos.overview: The Shinoa squad re-learns the hard cold fact that it's very possible to lose comrades, but there's no time to mourn. They must move on to go rescue the hostages. Right after their departure, Mika and the other vampires arrive to Nagoya as well.

videos.title: Shinya and Guren
videos.overview: Guren, Shinoa, and Narumi squads arrive at the city hall and see the hostages. Knowing it's a set-up, they still decide to go save the hostages, but Guren and Shinya are way over their heads with Crowley, as they struggle just to run away from him.

videos.title: Demon's Lullaby
videos.overview: Shinoa's squad goes to save Guren, but unfortunately, they run out of time. Reluctantly, they leave him behind and retreat, but Yu just cannot bring himself to do that. Instead, he takes more of the Curse Stimulant Pills to go save Guren himself.

videos.title: Traitorous Allies
videos.overview: Thanks to his "experimentation," Yu makes a miraculous recovery and once again, goes back to save Guren. Pushing too hard, Yu nearly becomes a demon, but Kimizuki stops him by force. The squad carries Yu out and heads for safety, but then encounters Mika.

videos.title: Yu and Mika
videos.overview: Yu and Mika are finally reunited, but the injuries Mika had sustained from fighting the Demon Company threatens his life. Determined to keep Mika alive, Yu tries to persuade Mika into drinking his blood... Even if it means Mika will become a true vampire.

videos.title: Arrogant Love
videos.overview: The survivors of the Moon Demon Company get to the rendezvous point, only to find out that their orders are to "standby." Enraged, they decide to ignore the orders to save Guren, when Kureto appears. Apparently, Kureto has something else on the agenda.

videos.title: Seraph of the End
videos.overview: Kureto's trump card was Mirai, Kimizuki's younger sister and another Seraph of the End test subject. In order to stop the Japanese Imperial Demon Army, Yu has no choice but to reach out to his inner "trumpet" to tap into the angel's powers.

language: Japanese, English, French, Portuguese, German, Spanish
